title: Meet Rosebud
content: There's a new life down on the farm. Her name is Rosebud. She's a miniature-horse filly, and she's less than two weeks old.She has four modes, which she alternates every ten minutes: 1. Running at top speed, 2. Nibbling on everything, 3. Nursing to refuel, and 4. Napping in a sunbeam.I tried to catch her during nap mode for a watercolor pencil portrait. When I was finished, she hopped up in nibble mode and wanted to know all about the sketchbook.Happy Easter, folks!------Previously on GJ: The Belgian filly Flashy Princess (compare her size)
